---
title: "check-exm-figures.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check that flags an example div (`#exm-`)
with no figure.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-23) is that nearly every example
gets a figure of its data, model or results.
This implements
[gha#1193](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1193).

A figure is any of these inside the example div:

- a Markdown image or an `<img>` tag;
- a div or chunk labelled `fig-`
  (`{#fig-...}`, `#| label: fig-...`, `#| fig-cap:` or `#| fig-alt:`);
- a cross-reference to a figure (`@fig-...`);
- an include of a figure subfile (`{{< include ..._fig.qmd >}}`).

A justified exception carries a reason:
an HTML comment `<!-- no-figure: reason -->` inside the div exempts it.
A comment with no reason does not.
Use `paths-ignore` to exempt whole paths.
The check does not count a div inside a code fence,
an HTML comment or a blockquote,
or the divs an `include` shortcode may pull in at render time.

## Scope

Only an example div that holds a line a pull request adds is reported,
so existing examples are never reflagged.
The whole file is parsed, since a div opens far above the changed line.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new, and a blank added line is not content.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file on purpose,
which measures how many existing examples lack a figure.
Every run prints how many lines, files and examples it examined.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default       | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd'`     | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`          | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `false`       | Fail the workflow when an example has no figure. The default gives warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`       | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`      | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-exm-figures.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags an example div (#exm-) with no figure when a PR
# adds a line to it. Add a figure, or <!-- no-figure: reason --> in the div.
# Warn-only by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check example figures

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-exm-figures.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd'                        # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: true                             # block instead of warn (defaults to false)
    #   whole-tree: true                       # scan every file, not just a PR's additions
```

See
[`examples/check-exm-figures.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-exm-figures.yml)
for the full caller stub.
